meaning: one way or another, no matter what

english.meaning: in some way; by some means
english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when the speaker means the task must be done one way or another.
Use this for “regardless” in the sense of proceeding whatever the preceding circumstances or discussion may be.

examples.english: We have to finish it before tonight somehow.
examples.traditional: 我哋點都要喺今晚之前完成。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dim2 dou1 jiu3 hai2 gam1 maan5 zi1 cin4 jyun4 sing4

examples.english: Regardless of what you say, I’m going.
examples.traditional: 你講咩都好，我點都會去。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gong2 me1 dou1 hou2 ngo5 dim2 dou1 wui5 heoi3
